text:
sofia: Quick sync — Project Loom customer asked for private deployment with per-tenant HSM, pinned model versions, and a 99.9% uptime SLA. Need cross-team sequencing and concrete launch criteria by EOD tomorrow. Who's in?
ethan: I'm in. Can we agree an MVP definition first? full HSM integration + multi-tenant isolation feels large.
priya: Runtime constraints: we can support pinned models and KV caching for tenants, but HSM handshake adds an external dependency and ~2-3 week work to integrate key rotation flows.
marco: Infra notes: private deployment (VPC + on-prem proxy) needs reserved capacity slots + routing. We have ~2 slots left in Q2 for a dedicated pilot cluster.
leah: Security: HSM onboarding requires an architecture review and one external pen test. Also need KMS access review for customer keys. That's a 4 week window from request -> approved.
sofia: Good notes. Proposal: split into phases — Phase 1 (Pilot): private control plane + pinned model support + basic tenant isolation (no HSM). Phase 2 (HSM): add per-tenant HSM, key rotation, and compliance artifacts. Phase 3: GA with SLA. Thoughts?
ethan: Phase-wise makes sense. Runtime can do Phase 1 in ~2 sprints if we minimize changes to model pipeline. For Phase 2 we need cross-team API for key provisioning and vault access.
priya: Agree. For Phase 1 I'd like a checklist: model pinning API, tenant kv cache boundaries, e2e smoke tests, and telemetry hooks. I can own telemetry hooks.
marco: I can reserve pilot cluster for Phase 1 if product confirms start date this quarter. Need an initial capacity estimate (qps, token/sec, model sizes).
sofia: I'll grab the customer traffic profile now and post it. Tentative start = two weeks from today if that helps.
ethan: Launch criteria suggestion for Phase 1 (minimal):
- end-to-end smoke test passing (generation and embeddings)
- p95 latency <= 200ms on pilot load
- infra cost estimate + reserved capacity confirmed
- runbook and rollback plan reviewed
- docs for tenant onboarding + sample config
priya: Add telemetry: token-level cost breakdown visible in console and per-tenant traces. Also a canary plan: 10% traffic -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 48 hours with rollback on errors >1%.
leah: Security launch criteria (Phase 1): threat model reviewed, auth/role matrix documented, secrets handling validated. Pen test for Phase 2 only.
sofia: Nice. Can we put a minimal canary config here?
priya: Sure — paste as a quick snippet:
```
canary_plan:
  - step: 10%
    duration: 12h
  - step: 25%
    duration: 12h
  - step: 50%
    duration: 24h
  - step: 100%
    duration: 24h
triggers:
  rollback_on_error_rate: 1%
  rollback_on_latency_p95_increase: 2x
```
marco: For capacity I'll need the model memory profiles and expected concurrency. If we default to small quantized weights for pilot, we can fit more tenants on the same pool.
ethan: Runtime risk: prefix cache isolation bugs could leak KV. We need a dedicated QA test that fuzzes tenant separation. I'll pair with QA.
leah: Ops-bot: Please schedule an architecture review slot with Security & Infra next week.
ops-bot: @sofia Meeting created: "Project Loom - Arch Review (Security+Infra)" on 2024-06-12 15:00 UTC. Invitees: sofia, ethan, priya, marco, leah. :calendar: 
sofia: Perfect — after the review I'll finalize the Phase 1 checklist and timeline. Thanks everyone, will post customer traffic profile in this thread in 30m. :thumbsup:
